title: `topics/quantum-randomness-channel-llm-consciousness` technical chain is wrong at four stages — RDRAND is DRBG output (conditioning precedes it), the "quantum mechanical properties of silicon" quote is from a 2000 Firmware Hub datasheet, /dev/urandom is ChaCha CRNG output, Philox is PyTorch's CUDA path only — and L65 misuses the Thinking Machines temperature-0 result
